title: OracleModule assumes that all Chainlink feeds have a heartbeat of 24 hours
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  In `OracleModule.sol`, there is a function to set the stale period of the chainlink feed.  ```   function setStalePeriod(uint32 _stalePeriod) public onlyOwner {     stalePeriod = _stalePeriod;   } ```  This stale period will check whether the `updatedAt` variable returned from the `latestRoundData()` call is up to date.  ```   function _isStale(uint256 timestamp) internal view returns (bool) {     return block.timestamp - timestamp <= stalePeriod ? false : true;   } ```  The `stalePeriod` is set at 90000 seconds (25 hours).
